sources.title: Reza2kn/Bina-0.4-Koochik · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Bina 0.4 Koochik is a 630,800,496-parameter image-to-text OCR model derived from NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Parse, with a C-RADIOv4-SO400M vision backbone and an autoregressive text decoder.

sources.title: Reza2kn/Bina-0.4-Koochik-ONNX-INT4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Bina 0.4 Koochik — ONNX-INT4 Calibration-aware 4-bit derivative of Reza2kn/Bina-0.4-Koochik, using checkpoint 18,404. The architecture and 630,800,496 unique parameters are unchanged. Original training was not modified.
